description.value: The undead creature grows bat wings and can fly at a speed of 30 feet (or 25 feet if it wears medium or heavy armor, or if it carries a medium or heavy load). It can ascend at half speed and descend at double speed, and its maneuverability is good. In addition, it gets a bite attack that deals 1d6 + its Strength modifier (or increases bite damage to the next size up if it already has a bite attack). Bite damage inflicted heals the undead creature.
